jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
IT Project Manager - Swatch Group

IT Project Manager
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and collaborative IT organization and play a key role in managing strategic projects across the American subsidiaries of the Group.
Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, enterprise architects and external partners, you will ensure the successful delivery of approved projects, from initial demand through handover to operations, while contributing to program management and supporting change initiatives.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Managing approved IT projects according to agreed budgets, timelines and scope.
• Ensuring effective project execution from demand intake to operational handover, following the Group’s project management methodology.
• Preparing and maintaining project documentation, investment requests and decision materials.
• Coordinating with enterprise architects to ensure proper architectural alignment during conceptual phases.
• Collaborating with external partners and ensuring proper follow‑up on deliverables.
• Communicating regularly with stakeholders, including business teams, management, PMO and related project teams.
• Supporting conflict resolution, resource coordination and scope management.
• Contributing to program management activities and facilitating change management across impacted teams.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Strong experience managing IT projects in a multinational environment.
• The ability to lead projects end‑to‑end, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IT strategy.
• Solid understanding of business processes, logistics flows and project governance.
• The capacity to coordinate diverse stakeholders and maintain clear, structured communication.
• A proactive, organized and solution‑oriented mindset.
• The ability to manage risks, dependencies and resources in a dynamic environment.
• A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, architects and external partners.
• Strong analytical abilities and the capacity to evaluate business demands and scope potential projects.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 10+ years of experience in IT project management.
• Experience working in a large multinational corporation with international exposure.
• Expertise in IT project management, including planning, execution and stakeholder coordination.
• Strong understanding of business management and logistics processes.
• Good knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including cloud, networking and data center environments.
• Experience with SAP S/4HANA or modules such as SD/MM or FI/CO is an asset.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to model information flows and support change management activities.
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent.
• Project management certifications (PMP, Scrum Master, etc.) are considered an asset.
• Languages
• Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Data Integration Engineer - Swatch Group

Data Integration Engineer
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join the Integration Competence Center (INTCC) within the Group IT Applications Division and contribute to the design, development and support of data integration and distribution solutions for the American markets.
Working closely with IT teams, architects, business stakeholders and external partners, you will help extend and operate the Group’s Single Source of Truth (SSOT) data hub, strengthen data integration capabilities and ensure the reliability of the integration landscape.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Designing, developing and enhancing data integration and distribution solutions across brands and countries.
• Implementing and extending the SSOT data hub using MS SQL, stored procedures and WebMethods components.
• Designing robust data integration architectures and data models to support business and IT needs.
• Supporting governance activities related to master data, interfaces and integration processes.
• Providing operational support for the integration landscape, including infrastructure, applications and middleware.
• Collaborating with developers, architects and cross‑functional teams to ensure high‑quality integration flows.
• Maintaining documentation related to processes, system setup, data models and integration components.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Strong experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development.
• The ability to design and implement integration solutions across multiple systems and markets.
• Hands‑on experience with MS SQL, stored procedures, SSIS/ETL tools and related plugins.
• Familiarity with EAI/ESB technologies, ideally Software AG WebMethods or similar stacks.
• Experience with APIs, XML, SOAP and REST‑based integrations.
• Exposure to SAP integration technologies such as IDocs, RFCs or ABAP debugging.
• A structured, analytical and solution‑oriented mindset.
• The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a technical team.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to interact with diverse stakeholders.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• +10 years of IT experience, including at least 2 years in designing and developing data integration or MDM solutions.
• At least 5 years of experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development.
• Expertise with MS SQL, stored procedures and relational database design.
• Strong experience with SSIS/ETL tools and plugins such as Theobald for SAP‑related integrations.
• Experience with WebMethods or other EAI/ESB platforms.
• Experience in Java/JEE development and object‑oriented programming.
• Experience developing web applications (AngularJS, WebMethods CAF UI or similar).
• Strong knowledge of XML, SOAP, REST and API‑based integrations.
• Experience with SAP integration technologies (IDoc, ALE, RFC, ABAP debugging) is an advantage.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent.
• Starting base salary range between 110k-140k/year (plus a yearly bonus potential)
• Languages
• Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

jobs.description:
Visual Merchandiser Trainer - Central Region - Swatch Group

Visual Merchandiser Trainer - Central Region
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Visual Merchandiser & Trainer with Tissot, U.S., the position will be responsible to support the watch sales within our retail and wholesale account through visual merchandising and training. This role will oversee the visual representation of our Tissot brand and products in all boutiques (retail and wholesale) within assigned Central Region. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer will also be responsible for maintaining training initiatives that will increase Tissot brand and product knowledge. Tasks include the planning, organization, coordination, training and implementation of all Visual Merchandising measures that have been developed by the brand.
This position is a field position.
Profile
Visual Merchandising 
• Responsibilities
Implement and maintain visual merchandising standards across retail and wholesale store locations, ensuring compliance with Company guidelines and brand standards.
Conduct regular store visits to evaluate visual execution, providing on-the-spot adjustments and recommendations.
Contribute to achieving sales volume goals by ensuring effective presentations and maintenance of all product categories, making sure that all stores are set up correctly during promotions and regular business.
Prepare and distribute communication materials related to visual displays in accordance with brand guidelines.
Manage vendor relationships by placing and following up on visual orders to ensure timely implementation and centralized mailing of visual materials to trade location.
Coordinate internal distribution of visual materials to stores, ensuring compliance and visibility.
Collaborate with retail locations, regional teams, and brand leadership to plan and execute floor sets, window displays, seasonal transitions, and promotional setups.
Identify visual merchandising opportunities within and outside stores, developing innovative window decoration ideas.
Create and maintain a photo library documenting boutique conditions before and after visits.
Provide recap reports summarizing store visit findings and improvement recommendations.
Assist Visual Manager and SIS Project Manager with identifying SIS opportunities and maintenance/renovation needs.
Lead first-class setup and decoration of brand-sponsored events, mono- and multi-brand related, to maximize visual impact.
Partner with management in planning and executing functional training, leadership development, product and sales training and other agreed training strategies.
Training & Development 
• Responsibilities
Facilitate training sessions for store managers and associates focused on current visual merchandising standards, product placement, and customer experience best practices.
Provide comprehensive communication and training programs to stores
Partner with management on planning and executing functional, leadership, product, and sales training programs.
Provide ongoing coaching to store teams, identifying skill gaps and recommending development initiatives.
Foster strong relationships with store teams to support adoption of visual and training standards.
Additional 
• Responsibilities
Monitor regional business trends, competitor trends by reading and understanding business reports and identify potential opportunities to support sales growth.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
Requirements
Education and Experience 
• Requirements
High School Diploma or GED required; College degree preferred.
2-3 years of retail visual merchandising experience, preferably in specialty goods, jewelry, or watches.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Valid driver’s license required.
Proven ability to coach and train diverse teams in a fast-paced retail environment.
Strong eye for design, layout, and brand storytelling through product presentation.
Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
The work schedule will vary from Monday through Friday and may include an occasional weekend.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 80-85% of the time (minimum 4 days per workweek).
Physical 
• Requirements:
This is primarily active position which requires the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer to move about the various locations while continuously climbing ladders, bending, stooping, lifting, reaching, moving and carrying up to 40 lbs. There is frequent travel to multiple retail locations within assigned territory. The position requires the ability to operate motor vehicles, computers and tablets, communicate clearly, and engage physically with visual merchandising setups. Finger dexterity is necessary. Occasional evening or weekend work to support store openings, seasonal transitions, or special events.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer. Duties, responsibilities and activities may evolve or change at any time with or without notice.
Compensation & Benefits
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount

Associé de Ventes / Sales Associate (Montreal Eaton Centre)
The company
Depuis 1853, Tissot est au cœur de l’horlogerie suisse. Notre engagement envers l’artisanat et la qualité est égalé seulement par notre passion pour la performance et la précision. Nos produits pionniers, comme le célèbre Tissot T-Touch, ont marqué l’histoire. Le Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar, alimenté par l’énergie solaire et doté de technologies connectées respectueuses de la vie privée, confirme notre réputation d’innovateurs par tradition.
Job description
• En tant qu’Associé de Ventes Tissot, vous relèverez du Responsable de Magasin et serez responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs de vente.
• Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle.
• Avantages :
• Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle
• Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise
• Rabais d’entreprise
• Assurance vie
• Les responsabilités sont les suivantes:
Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits.
• Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles.
• Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin.
• Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail.
• Conditions de travail:
Le travail est effectué avec un effort physique modéré et nécessite de marcher et de se tenir debout pendant la majeure partie de chaque période de travail. Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il nécessite de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir (jusqu'à 35 livres et plus avec un soutien approprié) des boîtes et des accessoires de magasin, ainsi que de se concentrer pour remplir des documents, gérer la trésorerie ou utiliser le point de vente.
Statut d’Emploi:
Temps Partiel: En moyenne 20 heures par semaine. Doit maintenir une disponibilité ouverte pour répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et peut être amené à travailler plus de 20 heures par semaine, y compris certains jours fériés et périodes de pointe.
Profile
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans les équipes d'ouverture et de fermeture ; horaires flexibles, y compris les week-ends et les jours fériés.
• Solides compétences en matière de communication (verbale et écrite), y compris de solides compétences en matière d'établissement de relations.
• Le candidat doit faire preuve d'initiative et être capable de travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.
• Capacité à communiquer de manière claire, concise et compréhensible.
• Orienté vers les résultats et doté d'un haut niveau d'énergie et d'enthousiasme.
• Passion pour la vente et le travail dans un environnement en évolution rapide.

• Au moins 2 an d’expérience en vente au détail, de préférence dans la mode et/ou les accessoires.
• Expérience avec les systèmes de point de vente (POS).

jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - East Coast
jobs.description:
Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - East Coast - Swatch Group

Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - East Coast
The Company
Hamilton has been an iconic name in precision watchmaking since its founding in Lancaster, Pennsylvania in 1892. Its watches have synchronized the first railroads and furnished the wrists of soldiers, aviators and Hollywood stars, making over 500 appearances on the big screen. Hamilton has been at the forefront of innovations in design, technology and craft by launching the world’s first electric timepiece in 1957 and LED digital watch in 1970. A member of the Swatch Group, the global leader in watch manufacturing and distribution, Hamilton combines its American spirit with true Swiss precision.
Job Description
As a Visual Merchandiser & Trainer with Hamilton, U.S., the position will be responsible to support the watch sales within our retail and wholesale account through visual merchandising and training. This role will oversee the visual representation of our Hamilton brand and products in all boutiques (retail and wholesale) within assigned East Coast region.
This position is a field position.
Profile
Visual Merchandising Responsibilities
• Implement and maintain visual merchandising standards across retail and wholesale store locations, ensuring compliance with Company guidelines and brand standards.
• Conduct regular store visits to evaluate visual execution, providing on-the-spot adjustments and recommendations.
• Contribute to achieving sales volume goals by ensuring effective presentations and maintenance of all product
categories, making sure that all stores are set up correctly during promotions and regular business.
• Prepare and distribute communication materials related to visual displays in accordance with brand guidelines.
• Manage vendor relationships by placing and following up on visual orders to ensure timely implementation and centralized mailing of visual materials to trade location.
• Coordinate internal distribution of visual materials to stores, ensuring compliance and visibility.
• Collaborate with retail locations, regional teams, and brand leadership to plan and execute floor sets, window displays, seasonal transitions, and promotional setups.
• Identify visual merchandising opportunities within and outside stores, developing innovative window decoration ideas.
• Create and maintain a photo library documenting boutique conditions before and after visits.
• Provide recap reports summarizing store visit findings and improvement recommendations.
• Assist Visual Manager and SIS Project Manager with identifying SIS opportunities and maintenance/renovation needs.
• Lead first-class setup and decoration of brand-sponsored events, mono- and multi-brand related, to maximize visual impact.
• Partner with management in planning and executing functional training, leadership development, product and sales training and other agreed training strategies.
Training & Development Responsibilities
• Facilitate training sessions for store managers and associates focused on current visual merchandising standards, product placement, and customer experience best practices.
• Provide comprehensive communication and training programs to stores
• Partner with management on planning and executing functional, leadership, product, and sales training programs.
• Provide ongoing coaching to store teams, identifying skill gaps and recommending development initiatives.
• Foster strong relationships with store teams to support adoption of visual and training standards.
Additional Responsibilities
• Monitor regional business trends, competitor trends by reading and understanding business reports and identify potential opportunities to support sales growth.
• Perform other duties as assigned by management.
Requirements
Education and Experience Requirements
• High School Diploma or GED required; College degree preferred.
• 2-3 years of retail visual merchandising experience, preferably in specialty goods, jewelry, or watches.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
• Valid driver’s license required.
• Proven ability to coach and train diverse teams in a fast-paced retail environment.
• Strong eye for design, layout, and brand storytelling through product presentation.
• Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• The work schedule will vary from Monday through Friday and may include an occasional weekend.
• Ability to domestically and internationally up to 80-85% of the time (minimum 4 days per workweek).
Physical Requirements:
This is primarily active position which requires the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer to move about the various locations while continuously climbing ladders, bending, stooping, lifting, reaching, moving and carrying up to 40 lbs. There is frequent travel to multiple retail locations within assigned territory. The position requires the ability to operate motor vehicles, computers and tablets, communicate clearly, and engage physically with visual merchandising setups. Finger dexterity is necessary. Occasional evening or weekend work to support store openings, seasonal transitions, or special events.
Additional Skill Requirements:
• Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Confident communicator and presenter.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and a quick learner.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Ability to remain engaged and responsive when working remotely.
• Flexibility to work extended hours when required.
• Willingness to accept feedback and continuously improve.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer. Duties, responsibilities and activities may evolve or change at any time
with or without notice.
Compensation & Benefits
The annual base salary range for this position is $70,000–$77,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience and skills. This position is also eligible for an annual bonus.
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave.
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount
For more information please see https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/

jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist
jobs.description:
Customer Service Specialist - Swatch Group

Customer Service Specialist
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
Swatch Group (U.S.) Inc. is looking for a self-motivated and energetic individual with a passion for providing excellent Customer Service and support to our various watch brands such as Omega, Tissot, Longines, Hamilton, and Swatch. This is not your traditional high volume call center environment. This position varies and involves working with Clients, Sales Representatives, and End-consumers.
Profile
Duties and Responsibilities
- Answer all customer inquiries including general information and pricing on the products
- Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
- Provide support to our brands and re-sellers
- Utilize company resources for product knowledge and proactive approach to constant refreshing of latest product offerings.
- Responds timely to email inquiries and facilitate departmental deadlines and goals.
- Assist customers by answering phone calls, placing product order and providing shipping status
- Research and respond to customer inquiries in person, phone and e-mail.
- Review and update customer records on computerized data base, SAP system.
- Resolve problems through partnerships with appropriate parties/department heads.
- Research timepieces and parts in the SAP.
- Assure the highest level of customer satisfaction including timely and adequate follow up process.
- Perform due diligence on customer inquiries through oral and written communication.
- Assist in providing initial training to new agents as and when required.
- All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education and Experience Requirements
- High School Diploma or GED is required
- Must have excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.
- Previous experience or Knowledge of SAP System is a plus
- Ability to multi-task and work under pressure while maintaining a high level of accuracy and organization.
- Must be highly organized with superior follow-up skills.
- Must be flexibility to work additional hours during peak season.
- Must be a dependable and reliable team player.
- Must be able to work well in fast-paced environment
- Must have the ability to learn new tasks as needed for upward growth (team and individual)
Physical Requirements
This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the Customer Service Specialist to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
It would be a huge plus if you have following work experiences: Customer Service Representative, Customer Service Associate, Customer Service Assistant, Customer Service Coordinator, and Customer Service Agent.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Customer Service Specialist duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay

Employee product discount

- Provide support to our brands and re-sellers

- Research and respond to customer inquiries in person, phone and e-mail.

- Resolve problems through partnerships with appropriate parties/department heads.
- Research timepieces and parts in the SAP.
- Assure the highest level of customer satisfaction including timely and adequate follow up process.
- Perform due diligence on customer inquiries through oral and written communication.
- Assist in providing initial training to new agents as and when required.
- All other duties assigned by Management

Education and Experience Requirements
- High School Diploma or GED is required
- Must have excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.

- Ability to multi-task and work under pressure while maintaining a high level of accuracy and organization.

jobs.title: OMEGA Client Advisor | Perth
jobs.description:
OMEGA Client Advisor | Perth - Swatch Group

OMEGA Client Advisor | Perth
About OMEGA
Since 1848, innovative watchmaking has been the cornerstone of OMEGA’s heritage, but it is also inspired by sports timekeeping, the conquest of space and of course its enviable role in support of the world’s favourite spy. Thanks to OMEGA’s pioneering spirit and iconic designs, the brand has established a reputation for quality and luxury that is renowned worldwide.
The Role
• As a full time Client Advisor, you will be an integral part of the team, providing exceptional customer service, driving sales and contributing to the overall success of the boutique.
• Support Boutique Management and wider team in achieving sales targets
• Ensure highest level of service standards at all times using the OMEGA sales ceremony
• Assist in developing and maintaining the client and VIP database
• Perform daily security stock counts
• Be responsible for organisation, refill, and storage of back up stock, visual merchandising material, product packaging, instruction booklets and warranties
• Develop own comprehensive OMEGA brand and product knowledge
• Assist in ensuring the boutique is kept clean and maintained
• Actively participate in training sessions and keeping up to date with E-learning modules
• Skills & Experience
• Minimum 2 years retail or hospitality experience in the luxury sector preferred
• Highly developed and proven customer service and client relationship skills
• Excellent organisational skills
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Good computer literacy skills
• Good time management skills
• Team player
• Energy, drive and enthusiasm
• Impeccable grooming and presentation
• Visual merchandising flair
• Full and flexible availability
• Luxury watch industry knowledge and experience an advantage
• Benefits
• Collaborative and supportive culture
• Generous employee discount across all Swatch Group brands
• Employee referral program with the opportunity to earn a cash reward
• Access to our Employee Assistance Program
• Comprehensive income protection insurance
• Novated leasing opportunities for electric vehicles
• Extensive professional Learning and Development program
• Opportunity to earn incentives on top of your base salary
• Complementary loan watch

jobs.description:
Store Manager Bilbao - Swatch Group

Store Manager Bilbao
The company
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries
Job description
SWATCH has an exciting opportunity for a Store Manager to join one of our stores in Bilbao.
As a Store Manager your main tasks will be:
• Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals.
• Develop the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clientelling, superior customer service, events, partnering and traffic generating actions.
• Ensure a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• Think strategically and drive the business to company standards.
• Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
Profile
The ideal candidate should be an experienced retail sales manager with a strong focus on boosting sales, providing refined customer service and demonstrating strong customer skills.
Communicative person, results and customer service oriented and with attention to Retail.
The experience within the watch industry and jewelry will be a plus.
Professional requirements
Flexibility is also needed to adapt the changes to Store needs.
Availability for shift work.
Intermediate level of informatics (Office).

Conversation level of English.
Knowledge in other language would be a plus.

Tissot Sales Associate
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Sales Associate with Tissot U.S., and the position will responsible for demonstrating outstanding customer service as per Brand standards, generate sales, merchandise and safeguard company assets. You will be expected to help client outreach initiatives, build brand awareness, assist in daily operations of the store. All positions support and assists management team in achieving all customer service and sales goals initiatives. You will be the brand, inside and outside the boutique.
Profile
Primary Duties and 
• Responsibilities:
Provide a unique and special experience to all clients
Reach & exceed your sales goals
Maintain and grow existing clients; keep records of milestones and client’s tastes and goals for future purchases
Assist in sales process as per established store protocols
Communicate customer requests to management.
Assist in the submission of daily reports and sales reconciliation reports
Assist in processing and replenishing merchandise and monitoring counter stock.
Develop existing client base and reach new prospects through networking and outreach
Actively participate in merchandising projects, ie: daily stock maintenance, display changeovers, product transfers, etc.
Provide superior after-sale service to all clients
Provide the highest level of client service through personalized contact in product maintenance
Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
Team-oriented
Actively support securing company assets through effective Loss Prevention in compliance with company policies and procedures
Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
Actively maintain the store appearance including keeping merchandise neatly organized and attractively displayed.
All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education and Experience 
• Requirements
Must have High School Diploma and/or equivalent
Must possess a strong luxury retail jewelry and time piece experience
All applicants should have 3-5 years of experience in a sales position, specialty luxury retail preferred
Driven to deliver superior service by exceeding customer expectations
Able to work well as a team player in a very fast-paced, energetic environment
Able to achieve sales goals and be goal oriented
Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
Must be able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
Must be able to sustain level of professionalism; friendly demeanor;
The ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff
Clientele building skills
Must be able to demonstrate basic computer literacy
Flexible to retail working hours including availability on weekends and holidays.
Ability to multi-task and handle changing priorities
Able to work well with minimal supervision; self-starter
Bilingual is a plus
Physical 
• Requirements:
This is primarily an active position, which requires the Sales Associate to have the ability to stand approximately 5 – 8 hours per day usually 5 - 7 days per week. During peak sale periods (e.g. Holiday, Back-to-School), will work for long periods throughout a work day. Requires to climb ladder or ascend/descend stairs in order to stock and/or acquire merchandise for sale. Required to lift items weighing 5 – 25 lbs regularly without assistance. In certain circumstances, weights may be higher. Required to work an average of 40 hours per week. Finger dexterity is necessary.
Schedule/Availability:
Work occurs on a variable schedule which could include early mornings, mornings, afternoons, evenings, late nights or overnights as well as weekends and holidays.

• Requirements:
Communicate in a clear, concise, understandable manner, and listen attentively to others, understand material, and provide instructions to all employees
Strong interpersonal, communication, organization and follow-through skills

Must be self-motivated and a self-starter; quick learner for a multifaceted business and companion domestic and international staff;

Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of
art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
As we prepare for the store reopening, we are expanding the team with additional positions
Job Description:
Ideal candidate will have retail sales experience, as well as Keyholder background. This position must possess exceptional customer service skills and a demeaner that embodies a great sense of approachability. Candidate should also have the ability to meet or exceed sales objectives and possess a strong desire to learn about our timepieces and looking to become an essential member of our team
Hourly Rate: $17.50 - $19.50/Hrly. (Plus Commission)
Profile
Profile:
Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
Reach & exceed your sales goals
Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
Handle multi-tasking with ease
Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment
Professional 
• Requirements
Professional 
• Requirements:
2 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position

jobs.description:
Full-Time Sales Lead (West Edmonton Mall) - Swatch Group

Full-Time Sales Lead (West Edmonton Mall)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
As a Swatch Sales Lead, you will report to the Store Manager and will assist in all day-to-day operations. Although your focus will be on sales initiatives, you also will coach sales associates to achieve their performance goals while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Build Effective Teams and Relationships, Creativity and Problem-Solving, and Humility and Integrity.
• Starting base pay of $18.90 per hour plus monthly performance bonus.
• Benefits:
• Health benefits, including dental and vision coverage
• RRSP contributions with company match
• Company discount
• Life insurance
• Responsibilities include:
• Customer Service & Sales Generation: Lead by example in delivering excellent customer service, set sales targets, coach the team to meet these targets, and ensure product knowledge is up to par.
• Operations: Manage daily operations, schedule staff efficiently, control payroll, adhere to inventory control processes, and ensure all reporting is accurate and timely.
Personnel Management: Oversee recruitment, training, and disciplinary processes to ensure a high-performing team, promote a positive work environment, and manage performance evaluations and development plans.
• Visual Merchandising: Execute merchandise launches in line with company standards and maintain store presentation.
• Compliance: Maintain safety standards, act as a policy and procedure role model.
• Working Conditions:
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS.
Profile
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Effective leadership skills to mentor and motivate retail team.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Professional requirements
• At least 2 years retail leadership experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Intermediate computer skills with working knowledge of MS Office.
• At least 4 years of customer service experience.
• Experience working with POS systems.

Hour Passion, eine Einzelhandelsmarke der Swatch Group, dem weltweit führenden Unternehmen in der Uhrenbranche, bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, in einem dynamischen, internationalen und anspruchsvollen Umfeld tätig zu sein.
Spezialisiert auf den Multi-Brand-Verkauf von Uhren und Schmuck renommierter Marken, begeistert Hour Passion eine anspruchsvolle internationale Kundschaft durch innovative Store-Konzepte und erstklassigen Kundenservice. Die Marke führt prestigeträchtige Kollektionen von Blancpain, Glashütte, Omega, Longines, Rado, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido und Hamilton.
• Seit 2004 ist Hour Passion in den bedeutendsten internationalen Flughäfen Europas und Asiens vertreten und bietet dort ein einzigartiges Einkaufserlebnis im Bereich der Uhrmacherkunst.
• Job description
• Für unsere Boutique Hour Passion am Flughafen Zürich suchen wir eine/n Sales Advisor
60-100%, welche/r eine Leidenschaft für Luxus hat, über nachweisliche Kenntnisse in der Uhrmacherei verfügt und sich in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterentwickeln möchte. Der Eintrittstermin ist nach Vereinbarung.
Ihre Aufgaben:
• Unsere Kunden mit Professionalität, Begeisterung und Aufmerksamkeit begrüßen und beraten
• Eine makellose Präsentation der Produkte und der Boutique sicherstellen
• Die Marken von Luxus, die wir anbieten, optimal zur Geltung bringen
• Die Kasse und Transaktionen präzise und sorgfältig verwalten
• Profile
• Sie haben eine Ausbildung oder nachweisliche Erfahrung im Verkauf, idealerweise im Bereich Uhren, Schmuck oder Luxusprodukte.
• Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Uhrmacherei (dies ist eine zwingende Voraussetzung)
• Professional requirements
• Sie sind flexibel, dynamisch und teamfähig
• Sie besitzen ein ausgezeichnetes Kommunikationsvermögen
• Sie haben ein gepflegtes und professionelles Erscheinungsbild
• Sie haben ein besonderes Gespür für Uhren und ihre Geschichte.
• Languages
• Sie beherrschen Deutsch und Englisch fliessend, weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil

jobs.title: Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain
jobs.description:
Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain
The company
Blancpain, founded in 1735 by Jehan-Jacques Blancpain in the Swiss Jura, Blancpain is known as the world’s oldest watch brand.
Over the centuries since its foundation, the Maison has maintained its commitment to innovate and has constantly pushed the limits of watchmaking. At Blancpain, the expression "Innovation is our tradition" is a fundamental guiding principle.
The Fifty Fathoms collection embodies Blancpain's passion for the underwater world that was originally expressed in 1953 with the presentation of the first modern diver’s watch Fifty Fathoms.
With the creation of the Blancpain Ocean Commitment, the brand pays homage to its Brand’s significant historical links with the ocean, through the support for ocean exploration and numerous collaborative initiatives for biodiversity preservation with local communities, which has been lasting for the past seven decades.
As part of the Art of Living platform, Blancpain also cultivates special ties with the greatest award-winning chefs, the Michelin Guide, Relais & Chateaux and Bocuse d’Or.
Job description
Key 
• Responsibilities
Sales and Business Development
Provide excellent client experience and timely, pertinent follow-up for both prospective clients and owners (Customer service)
Propose clients for, and participate in, local activation events in line with the Brand Universe
Support colleagues in their sales by helping to prepare invoices, gifts, packaging
Ensure requests and enquiries (online, email, phone) are followed up in a timely manner
Develop and maintain a high level of sales technique and watchmaking savoir-faire knowledge
Follow-up with customer repairs liaising with customer care in Southampton and Swiss headquarters.
Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
Placing orders for Blancpain accessories, ensuring stock is upto date and available
Boutique Operations
Actively participate in the proper maintenance of the boutique: product displays, props set-up, etc.
Understand and respect all operating and security guidelines
Follow the security and proper maintenance of stock timepieces
Profile
Preferred 
• Profile
Previous sales experience in a luxury Retail boutique or Hospitality industry
Excellent client service and attention to details
Entrepreneurial spirit to develop your own business and build long-lasting client relationships
Team player with good interpersonal skills and a "can do" attitude
Intellectual curiosity and a passion for learning
Strong interest in the universes of Fine Watchmaking and Arts de Vivre
Job location
11 New Bond Street W1S 3SR
W1S 3SR London (London)
United Kingdom
Company address
The Swatch Group (UK) Limited
77 Marsh Wall
12th Floor
London E14 9SH

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Sales & Marketing Manager - Swatch Group

Sales & Marketing Manager
The company
About Mido
Mido — a brand where timeless Swiss craftsmanship meets innovation and precision. Since 1918, Mido has been creating watches that combine performance, reliability, and elegant design, inspired by a rich heritage of watchmaking excellence.
Join us to be part of a journey that values quality, passion, and continuous innovation!
Job description
Key 
• Responsibilities
Account Management/Retail Partner Relations
Serve as the primary point of contact and brand representative for
authorised retail partners across Malaysia.
Develop and maintain a structured account management cadence, including regular store visits, business reviews, and seasonal range presentations.
Negotiate and manage sell-in volumes, seasonal buys, and trading terms in collaboration with the Country Manager/Mido HQ, ensuring commercial targets are met while preserving healthy partner margins.
Proactively identify and address challenges within accounts.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date account records.
Inventory, Replenishment & Other Management
Monitor auto-replenishment systems across all points of sale, reviewing stock positions on a regular basis and taking corrective action when replenishment triggers are not performing as expected.
Execute all ordering and replenishment activities through Arkieva.
Manage the full stock and collection cycle.
Oversee the payment collection process for stock and collections.
Liaise with logistics teams to resolve any issues that could impact partner operations.
Sales Reporting & Performance Analysis
Prepare and submit weekly & monthly sales performance report, highlighting notable trends, risks, and opportunities for the attention of management.
Conduct monthly store visits across the wholesale network and consolidate detailed visit reports.
Track and analyse key performance indicators across all points of sale, identify underperforming accounts and working collaboratively with partners to develop improvement plans.
Ensure all reporting is accurate, consistently formatted, and aligned with the Brand/Group’s reporting standards.
Visual Merchandising & Brand Standards
Work closely with retail partners to implement and maintain VM setups according to brand guidelines.
Ensuring all partner locations receive updated materials in a timely manner.
Maintain a photographic record of VM standards across all points of sale.
Retail Staff Training & Brand Education
Design and deliver training programmes for retail partner staff.
Develop training materials and conduct regular training sessions.
Build a culture of brand advocacy among retail partner staff.
In-Store Activations & Retail Partner Collaboration
Collaborate with retail partners to identify joint market opportunities
Conceptualize, plan, and execute in-store activations, product launch events, and seasonal promotions that attract consumers, increase dwell time, and drive purchase conversion.
Digital Marketing & Press Relations
Develop and manage digital marketing campaigns tailored to the Malaysia market, working across owned channels (social media, CRM, website) and paid media to reach and engage target consumers at relevant touchpoints in the purchase journey.
Manage relationships with local press contacts, watch and lifestyle media editors, and digital content creators, proactively pitching stories, collections, and brand moments to generate earned media coverage.
Profile
Preferred 
• Profile
Minimum 7 years’ experience in wholesale sales, account management, or brand management, ideally within watches, jewellery, luxury goods, or lifestyle.
Demonstrated track record of managing retail partner relationships and driving sell-through in a wholesale distribution model.
Hands-on experience with inventory or retail planning systems; familiarity
with Arkieva is an advantage.
Exposure to digital marketing, social media management, and PR or media
coordination.
Experience planning and executing in-store activations or trade marketing
events.
Job location
Jalan Raja Chulan 67
50200 Kuala Lumpur (Kuala Lumpur)
Malaysia
Company address
The Swatch Group (Malaysia) SDN BHD
Level 22 Wisma Goldhill
67, Jalan Raja Chulan
MY-50200 Kuala Lumpur

jobs.title: Sales Associate - Tissot
jobs.description:
Sales Associate - Tissot - Swatch Group

Sales Associate - Tissot
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
The cross of the Swiss flag, proudly featured in the logo, symbolises the quality and reliability that Tissot has demonstrated since 1853. Remaining true to its motto, “Innovators by Tradition”, Tissot makes excellence accessible in more than 160 countries, relying on special materials, advanced features, and refined design.
Role Overview
As part of the expansion of our retail network, Tissot is looking for a passionate, dynamic, and customer-focused Sales Associate to join our boutique in Brussels. This temporary opportunity offers strong potential for long-term growth into a permanent position.
Your Mission
As a true brand ambassador, you will deliver an exceptional customer experience while contributing to the boutique’s visibility, commercial success, and premium image.
Your Key 
• Responsibilities
Welcome every customer with professionalism and provide a premium in-store experience aligned with brand standards
Advise and guide clients in selecting watches and related products
Actively contribute to achieving and exceeding sales targets
Perform watch bracelet adjustments and sizing
Handle cash register operations, including opening, closing, and payments
Ensure the boutique is always impeccably presented and maintained
Support stock replenishment and inventory management
Follow all procedures and guidelines related to brand image, security, and store operations
Growth & Continuous Learning
At Tissot, we believe in curiosity, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.
You will:
Continuously develop your product expertise and sales skills
Participate in regular training sessions
Grow within a collaborative environment that encourages teamwork and best-practice sharing
Profile
Who You Are
You are passionate about people, premium products, and delivering outstanding service. You thrive in a fast-paced retail environment and enjoy commercial challenges.
You are likely the ideal candidate if you:
Have a strong customer-service mindset
Are passionate about watches, retail, or premium products
Bring positive energy, enthusiasm, and excellent interpersonal skills
Have strong communication and sales abilities
Enjoy teamwork and dynamic environments
Can multitask efficiently with attention to detail
Are flexible and available to work weekends
Are reliable, organized, and motivated
Why Join Us?
Become part of an iconic Swiss watchmaking brand
Join a passionate and supportive team
Be part of an exciting retail journey in the heart of Brussels
Benefit from a genuine opportunity to grow into a permanent role
Enjoy a competitive salary package and comprehensive additional benefits, including: hospitalization insurance, meal vouchers, eco vouchers, 13th-month salary, and reimbursement of public transportation expenses
Professional requirements
Experience
At least 1 year of sales experience is required, ideally in watches, luxury, or premium retail
What We Value
Customer focus
Results-driven mindset
Flexibility and adaptability
Organization and attention to detail
Curiosity and willingness to learn
Emotional intelligence and analytical thinking
Languages
Bilingual French–English or Dutch-English (fluent in both spoken and written communication), with additional languages considered a strong asset.
Job location
Galerie de la Reine 2
1000 Bruxelles (Brussels)
Belgium
Company address
The Swatch Group (Belgium) SA
The Bridge
Chaussée de Mons 1424
BE-1070 Brussels

jobs.description:
Associé de Ventes / Sales Associate (Montreal Eaton Centre) - Swatch Group

Associé de Ventes / Sales Associate (Montreal Eaton Centre)
The company
Depuis 1853, Tissot est au cœur de l’horlogerie suisse. Notre engagement envers l’artisanat et la qualité est égalé seulement par notre passion pour la performance et la précision. Nos produits pionniers, comme le célèbre Tissot T-Touch, ont marqué l’histoire. Le Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar, alimenté par l’énergie solaire et doté de technologies connectées respectueuses de la vie privée, confirme notre réputation d’innovateurs par tradition.
Job description
• En tant qu’Associé de Ventes Tissot, vous relèverez du Responsable de Magasin et serez responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs de vente.
• Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle.
• Avantages :
• Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle
• Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise
• Rabais d’entreprise
• Assurance vie
• Les responsabilités sont les suivantes:
Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits.
• Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles.
• Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin.
• Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail.
• Conditions de travail:
Le travail est effectué avec un effort physique modéré et nécessite de marcher et de se tenir debout pendant la majeure partie de chaque période de travail. Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il nécessite de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir (jusqu'à 35 livres et plus avec un soutien approprié) des boîtes et des accessoires de magasin, ainsi que de se concentrer pour remplir des documents, gérer la trésorerie ou utiliser le point de vente.
Statut d’emploi :
Temps plein : En moyenne 35 heures par semaine. Vous devez maintenir une disponibilité ouverte afin de répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et pourriez être amené(e) à travailler plus de 35 heures par semaine, y compris certains jours fériés et durant les périodes de pointe.
Profile
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans les équipes d'ouverture et de fermeture ; horaires flexibles, y compris les week-ends et les jours fériés.
• Solides compétences en matière de communication (verbale et écrite), y compris de solides compétences en matière d'établissement de relations.
• Le candidat doit faire preuve d'initiative et être capable de travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.
• Capacité à communiquer de manière claire, concise et compréhensible.
• Orienté vers les résultats et doté d'un haut niveau d'énergie et d'enthousiasme.
• Passion pour la vente et le travail dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
• Professional requirements
• Au moins 2 an d’expérience en vente au détail, de préférence dans la mode et/ou les accessoires.
• Expérience avec les systèmes de point de vente (POS).
• Job location
• Saint Catherine Street West 705
• H3B 4G5 Montreal Quebec HB G (Quebec)
• Canada
• Company address
• The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd.
• 555, Richmond Street West
• Suite 1105
• CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario
• Apply for this job
• Share this job offer

Associé de Ventes / Sales Associate (Montreal Eaton Centre)
The company
Depuis 1853, Tissot est au cœur de l’horlogerie suisse. Notre engagement envers l’artisanat et la qualité est égalé seulement par notre passion pour la performance et la précision. Nos produits pionniers, comme le célèbre Tissot T-Touch, ont marqué l’histoire. Le Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar, alimenté par l’énergie solaire et doté de technologies connectées respectueuses de la vie privée, confirme notre réputation d’innovateurs par tradition.
Job description

• Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle.
• Avantages :
• Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle
• Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise
• Rabais d’entreprise
• Assurance vie
• Les responsabilités sont les suivantes:
Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits.
• Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles.
• Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin.
• Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail.
• Conditions de travail:
Le travail est effectué avec un effort physique modéré et nécessite de marcher et de se tenir debout pendant la majeure partie de chaque période de travail. Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il nécessite de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir (jusqu'à 35 livres et plus avec un soutien approprié) des boîtes et des accessoires de magasin, ainsi que de se concentrer pour remplir des documents, gérer la trésorerie ou utiliser le point de vente.

Temps plein : En moyenne 35 heures par semaine. Vous devez maintenir une disponibilité ouverte afin de répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et pourriez être amené(e) à travailler plus de 35 heures par semaine, y compris certains jours fériés et durant les périodes de pointe.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Electronic Modules
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager - Electronic Modules - Swatch Group

Business Development Manager - Electronic Modules
The company
We are looking for an entrepreneurial and technically minded Senior Business Development Manager to accelerate our growth across the DACH region. You will drive market expansion for innovative electronic modules focused on Bluetooth® Low Energy and ultra-low-power applications.
Our solutions enable next-generation Asset Tracking, Localization, Identification, and IoT connectivity for industries such as Logistics, Warehousing, Avionics, Healthcare, Hospitality, and Large Enterprise environments.
This role is designed for a high-energy sales professional who combines strategic vision with hands-on execution, who enjoys building customer relationships in the field, identifying market opportunities, and turning technical innovation into commercial success.
Why to Join Us
Be part of a growing, innovation-driven business
Work with cutting-edge ultra-low-power technologies
Direct impact on strategic growth and market expansion
High visibility within the organization and close collaboration with leadership
Dynamic international environment with entrepreneurial spirit
Opportunity to shape future connected-device ecosystems
Job description
Your Mission
Develop and execute the business development strategy for the DACH region
Drive sustainable revenue growth aligned with Business Unit targets
Identify and win new business opportunities within target verticals
Build strong relationships with OEMs, system integrators, distributors, and strategic partners
Support the on-boarding and mentoring of future sales talents as the organization grows
Your 
• Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales
Identify opportunities and close deals as a result of the full sales cycle support
Achieve and measure Biz Dev KPIs and ensure alignment with the Business Unit revenue targets
Develop strategic account plans and regional growth strategies
Identify new customers and market opportunities
Conduct customer visits and maintain strong field presence across the region
Represent the company at trade fairs
Drive C-level interaction between EM and customers / eco-system partners
Lead the commercial negotiations and drive the execution of development contracts with the different internal and external stakeholders (R&D, legal, quality and logistics)
Strategic Collaboration
Work closely with BUs Product Management, and Development to refine go-to-market strategies
Provide market feedback to influence product roadmap and innovation priorities
Collaborate with Marketing Communication teams to support campaigns, and market positioning
Interface effectively with Account Managers
Market & Technical Engagement
Understand customer application requirements and translate them into solution opportunities
Promote Bluetooth® Low Energy and ultra-low-power technologies in customer ecosystems
Support customers during evaluation and early project phases
Profile
Personality & Mindset
Strong business acumen with ability to handle strategic and action level aspects
Hands-on and action-oriented personality
“Hunter” attitude, strong commercial instinct and negotiation capability
Self-driven, autonomous, able to prioritize and highly customer-focused
Strong networking and relationship-building skills
Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for technology and innovation
Ideal Candidate 
• Profile
You are not just a salesperson — you are a business builder. You enjoy opening doors, understanding customer pain points, and transforming technical innovation into long-term partnerships. You are equally comfortable discussing strategy with management as walking a floor with end users. You thrive in dynamic environments and want to actively shape growth rather than groom existing business.
Professional requirements
Experience & 
• Profile
Proven experience in electronic components, module, or IoT solution sales (min. 10years)
Experience in business development within technical B2B environments
Excellent market knowledge and familiarity with industries such as logistics, healthcare, industrial automation, or enterprise IoT
Good understanding of wireless technologies, ideally Bluetooth® Low Energy
Experience working within the DACH business culture and environment
Self-starter and high intrinsic drive to deliver business results
Experience in contractual work
Languages
Fluent English required. Ideal: Fluent German. Bonus: French
Job location
Rue des Sors 3
2074 Marin (Neuchatel)
Switzerland
Company address
EM Microelectronic-Marin Ltd
CH-2074 Marin-Epagnier
Apply for this job

jobs.title: OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Bellagio
jobs.description:
OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Bellagio - Swatch Group

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Bellagio
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Job description
The Ideal candidate must be experienced in luxury retail sales and operations management with a strong focus on driving sales, delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientele skills. The applicant of choice should have a proven track record of longevity with prior luxury employers. The Luxury Assistant Manager leads retail operations, helps manage selling and supervises staff. He/she must possess the ability to build revenue and operational excellence.
Profile
• •Must possess excellent computer skills such as; Using operating systems(Windows, SAP, Cegid and emailing (Microsoft Outlook)
• •Performs and manages daily activities of operating luxury boutique as per company standards inclusive of maximizing inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• •Delegate tasks to the sales team.
• •Develop sales incentives and rewards
• .•Deliver sales results as per company goals.
• •Ensures a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• •Brings positive recognition to the Omega brand through effective communication, enthusiastic attitude, professionalism and in-depth brand knowledge
• .•Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs
• .•Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• •Lead employees by example, uphold company initiative and confidentiality
• Professional requirements
• Required Skills:
• Must possess luxury experience
• Minimum 3 years operations management experience
• Excellent selling and customer service skills.
• Superior communications skills: spoken and written.
• Inventory management expertise.
• Luxury retail experience preferred.
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
• 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay
• Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Employee product discount
• Transitchek Program – Save money on commuting to work and/or parking with up to $270 pre-tax dollars per month
• Internal transfer and growth potential
• $500 Employee Referral Bonuses
• Free parking (if applicable)

jobs.description:
Sales Advisor 100% - Genève - Swatch Group

Sales Advisor 100% - Genève
The company
Swatch Group est un leader mondial dans la conception, la fabrication et la vente de montres, bijoux, ainsi que de mouvements et composants horlogers de haute précision. Le groupe se distingue également comme acteur clé dans la fabrication de systèmes électroniques innovants, utilisés dans l’horlogerie et d’autres secteurs industriels.
Swatch Group Les Boutiques SA gère les réseaux de distribution multimarques en Suisse et dispose de plusieurs boutiques à travers le pays. Afin de renforcer nos équipes à Genève, nous recherchons un(e) :
Sales Advisor 100%
• Job description
• Vous contribuerez activement au bon fonctionnement du point de vente en garantissant un accueil client de qualité et en assurant une présentation soignée des produits.
• Tâches :
• Accueillir et accompagner la clientèle en offrant un service personnalisé.
• Participer activement aux opérations quotidiennes et soutenir l’équipe en boutique.
• Contribuer à la gestion de la caisse et aux opérations d’encaissement.
• Veiller à la bonne tenue de l’espace de vente : présentation des produits et respect des standards de merchandising.
• Appliquer les procédures internes mises en place par la société
• Profile
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience préalable dans la vente.
• Des connaissances dans le domaine de l'horlogerie constituent un sérieux atout.
• Professional requirements
• Vous êtes proactif, à l’aise dans les relations humaines et faites preuve de flexibilité.
• Vous êtes orienté client et disposez d’une bonne capacité d’écoute.
• Vous avez une excellente présentation et un sens aigu du service.
• Vous avez de la facilité avec les tâches administratives.
• Languages
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais ; la connaissance d'une autre langue est un atout.
• Vous recherchez un nouveau défi et êtes prêt à entrer dans l’aventure ? Le monde de l’horlogerie vous passionne ? N’hésitez pas à postuler directement en ligne.
• Contact
• Carla Tenthorey

jobs.title: Sales Lead (Conestoga Mall)
jobs.description:
Sales Lead (Conestoga Mall) - Swatch Group

Sales Lead (Conestoga Mall)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
As a Swatch Sales Lead, you will report to the Store Manager and will assist in all day-to-day operations. Although your focus will be on sales initiatives, you also will coach sales associates to achieve their performance goals while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Creativity, Problem-Solving, Humility, Integrity, Building Effective Teams and Relationships.
Starting base pay of $19.85 per hour plus monthly performance bonus.
Responsibilities include:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Lead by example to deliver outstanding customer service, coaching the team to meet and exceed sales targets. Ensure comprehensive product knowledge across the team to enhance customer experience and decision-making.
Operations: Support store management in daily operational tasks with a focus on accuracy and efficiency in all transactions. Maintain adherence to inventory control processes, minimizing loss and ensuring accuracy in stock handling and reporting.
Visual Merchandising: Execute and maintain visual merchandising standards in alignment with company directives. Ensure the store presentation is consistently maintained to a high standard, reflecting the brand’s image.
Compliance: Uphold workplace safety standards and act as a model for company policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with all operational guidelines and safety regulations.
Working Conditions:
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS.
Employment Status:
Full-Time: 35 hours per week on average. Must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 35 hours per week, including certain holidays and blackout dates.
Profile
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Passion for sales and working in fast paced environment.
• Professional requirements
• At least 2 years retail sales experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Intermediate computer skills with working knowledge of MS Office.
• Experience working with POS systems.
• Job location
• 550 King St N
• N2L 5W6 Toronto MV B (Ontario)
• Canada
• Company address
• The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd.
• 555, Richmond Street West
• Suite 1105
• CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario
